parties.respondent: The Special Secretary-Cum-District Collector And Others

summary: SC community certificate eligibility for reconversion; caste determined by birth, remains under eclipse post-conversion; reconversion requires sincere return to original community customs; religious conversion does not sever caste linkage; baptism record at infancy insufficient to deny claim; precedents cited on Hindu reconversion standards; nativity and continuous residence requirements examined; impugned orders rejecting certificate application overturned.
legal_provisions_cited: Principal, Guntur Medical College v. Mohan Rao
KP Manu v. Chairman, Scrutiny Committee
Mohammad Sadique v. Darbara Singh Guru
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned orders set aside; directive to issue Scheduled Caste community certificate following reconversion principles.
